Title: Public preview: Node OS API options feature for AKS

Body.Content:
Node OS API options feature for AKS is now in public preview. This feature allows those without Kubernetes API access to get private IP & name information of a node in a nodepool using the ARM API. This is useful in situations such as when you need Node API for troubleshooting.

To learn more, visit: Connect to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) cluster nodes - Azure Kubernetes Service | Microsoft Learn
